title: The Moon
sub: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 3 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. The Moon as the body's water, memory and the restless mind, manifestation through the observer effect, protective deities, a house-by-house reading of the Moon as mother, and the name remedy, with video timestamps.
desc: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 3, The Moon by Brajesh Gautam: water, memory, manifestation, protective deities, Moon by house, and the name and gemstone remedies, with video timestamps.
points: Pride stiffens the body; flexibility settles it.
The body is roughly 72 percent water, and he reads rigidity, not food, as the real source of brittleness.
The Moon is the fastest, most restless planet.
It changes sign every two and a quarter days and is said to govern the mind, memory and the body's water.
Wanting an outcome too hard can work against you.
His safer default is "I don't care either way, and whatever happens will be for the good."
Everyone carries a protective and an opposing deity.
Both come from the chart's 9th house and run automatically, whatever religion, or none, a person practises.
A disturbed Moon shows up in ordinary life, not just a label.
Leaks at home, low immunity, OCD, constant comparison and hallucination are his listed signs.
The main fixes are food timing, charity, gemstones and a name check.
Sunset food rules, anonymous giving, pearl, and checking whether your name's first letter sits in a hostile house.
Hypnosis, mantra and manifestation share one mechanism in his telling.
Repeated suggestion, for better or worse, is what shapes the restless mind he calls the Moon.
